## Exact additive delivery

Deliver one cumulative successor preserving actual accepted PR #2082, commit 7ef13f96c0005b6e181a640005bd867bbc2f63d0. Its 285,582 native keys, 792 complete ledger rows and 112 authorities remain literal. Add exactly 580 keys in 41 rows under 19 original authority groups, producing 286,162 keys, 833 rows and 131 authorities across 41 distinct contribution targets.

Original package accounting remains on #1880 (Myanmar), #2061 (Vietnam) and the Indonesia original package issues. This joint issue authorizes delivery only; it does not close the original repair or physical packages.

- Myanmar: 147 already-qualified original repair keys, plus all 28 original source-conflict questions (7 Myanmar and 21 Thai display choices). The exact 23 original intervals, candidate-owner arrays, all 26 source SIDs, physical classes and original pointers join to Main's literal adoption and the genuine 7+21 native patches. All 28 are disjoint from the original 18,459 physical questions and absent from the predecessor map. Retain the missing historical 2,515-byte review-file gap and the genuine new distinct reviews/adoptions explicitly.
- Vietnam: 357 original repair keys, comprising 9 previously qualified and 348 newly qualified under the independently reviewed #2083 source-adoption route. All 17 remaining territorial-exclusion cases remain held and are excluded. #2083 must be actually accepted before this selected delivery consumes its v3 evidence. The reviewed code may be used privately now, with its actual vintage identified.
- Indonesia: 46 original repair keys plus 2 original source-conflict keys from the independently reviewed 48-key contribution at 1c79c1635d6ba0af2fadbf1a700dd90d68020826. Preserve all original source/physical aliases and contextual contacts. The other 25 original conflict keys were already accepted; package closure requires the full original 27-question intersection after integration.

## Preservation and verification

1. Use the actual stock composer/finalizer. Conservation must preserve every accepted predecessor owner/cell assignment, literal ledger row and authority. No prior loss, reassignment or cross-owner duplicate coordinate is allowed.
2. Reuse the genuine 19 original qualification quartets and source/physical/native proof outputs. New composition is metadata work; do not rerun unchanged science or relabel its actual historical code/input/receipt identities. The actual 580 compose completed against accepted 7ef in 18.284 seconds.
3. Derive consumed role restoration and package declarations through the stock finalizer. Restore only genuinely absent byte-exact original read roles; never overwrite existing accepted paths. Preserve all prior package inputs in order and every non-input policy field, appending only genuinely uncovered selected-consumer leaves.
4. Retain original complete source operands, negative contacts, rights/vintage/uncertainty qualifications and unresolved scientific questions. Source choice expresses the existing map display convention, not legal or historical jurisdiction. No source geometry, hierarchy, native algorithm, application, workflow, deployment or live import changes are included.
5. Construct one stock evidence manifest binding the exact baseline pins below, the contribution target list and actual final outputs. Keep genuine numerical composition and code execution vintages honest. Remove duplicate author-side validation already performed by that constructor; retain final-head/tree binding, exact public batch readback and distinct substantive final review.
6. Parent Main owns final review and the serialized queue. Native delivery credit and original-package closure follow actual acceptance and exact original-question intersections. Until then this packet contributes zero accepted native keys. When the entire original source28 and Indonesia source27 packages are proved complete, retire each full original denominator honestly rather than counting only the new chosen owners.
